findings.detail: X02 incorrectly requires an interest rate for unfunded/undrawn debt rows whose source rate fields are intentionally blank.

rationale: The raw schedule explicitly classifies the affected positions as Undrawn and shows dashes in Reference, Spread, and Interest Rate. Multiple source rows exhibit the same structure, while funded companion rows are labeled Drawn and carry rates. Therefore the missing interest_rate is source-faithful and X02 is out of scope for these unfunded commitments. No aggregate anchor is relevant to this field-level rule-scope adjudication.
